sentences.text:
Mr. R. Mangal, learned counsel for the respondent
State accepts notices on behalf of respondent No.1.
Issue notice to the respondent No.2.

Fresh Pf for issuance of notice to respondent No.2 along with
complete set of documents within 7 days.
In the meanwhile, operation of the impugned order shall remain stayed subject to the appellant's depositing 50% of the amount, as mentioned in the order dt. 10/12/2012.
It is made clear that in case the amount has already been deposited, there is no necessity to deposit the same again.

Office to issue notices.
Learned counsel for the respondent State is directed to seek instructions.
Office is directed to requisition the record.

Office is also directed to verify whether the present appeal has to be registered as Second --- 2 --- Appeal or Misc. Appeal, as it is an Appeal filed u/S. 71(6) of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006.

(S. C. SHARMA) JUDGE KR Navneet Kumar Garg vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 26 August, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82060074/
